claim: Villa Crespi is a 19th-century Moorish-revival mansion in Orta San Giulio, Province of Novara, Piedmont, on Lake Orta.
quote: Villa Crespi is a Moorish Revival-style rural mansion located in Orta San Giulio, Province of Novara, Piedmont, Italy.

claim: Stresa is about 23 km by road from Orta San Giulio (≈14 miles).
quote: The road distance from Villa Crespi to Stresa is 13.8 miles (approximately 22.2 km).

claim: Baveno is about 25 km by road from Orta San Giulio.
quote: Baveno is approximately 14.5 miles from Villa Crespi (approximately 23.3 km).

claim: Verbania is about 29 km by road from Orta San Giulio.
quote: To Verbania: 18.3 miles road distance (~29.4 km).

claim: Arona is about 19 km by road from Orta San Giulio.
quote: To Arona: 11.9 miles road distance (~19.1 km).

claim: The 15th Technology Forum took place on 21–22 May 2026 at the Grand Hotel des Iles Borromées in Stresa, organised by TEHA Group (The European House — Ambrosetti).
quote: Technology Forum 2026 — 21-22 May 2026, Grand Hotel des Iles Borromées, Stresa.

claim: Technology Forum 2026 ran 21 May 14:00–19:30 and 22 May 08:30–14:15, targeted at CEOs, investors and innovators, with access reserved to InnoTech Hub subscribers.
quote: 21 maggio 2026 - 22 maggio 2026 ... Grand Hotel des Iles Borromées ... CEO, investitori e innovatori ... L'accesso è riservato agli iscritti al Servizio InnoTech Hub.

claim: The 2026 Forum agenda covered agentic AI, AI Giga Factories, deep tech, nuclear innovation, future factories and European digital sovereignty.
quote: Agentic AI ... AI Giga Factories ... Deep Tech strategies and investments ... Future factories ... European digital sovereignty.

claim: Technology Forum 2026 was listed under the categories TLC, Digital and Cybersecurity, plus Business.
quote: 21 Mag 2026 ore 09:00 - 22 Mag 2026 alle 18:00 ... TLC, Digital e Cybersicurezza ... Impresa.

claim: The CIO Leaders Summit 2026 was held 24–26 March 2026 at the Grand Hotel Dino in Baveno; by-invitation only for ~80–100 CIOs of Italian groups.
quote: 24, 25 e 26 Marzo 2026 ... Grand Hotel Dino a Baveno, Lago Maggiore ... I CIO dei principali gruppi italiani ... L'evento non è trasmesso in streaming.

claim: TEDxVerbania 2026 is scheduled for 21 November 2026 at 10 Corso Zanitello, Verbania; open to the public.
quote: November 21, 2026 ... 10 Corso Zanitello, Verbania, Piemonte, 28922, Italy ... This event is open to the public.

claim: 'Tecnologia e comunità oggi' — a talk on authentic relationships in the digital age with media-education expert Andrea Pozzi — was held 7 March 2026 at Museo La Manèra, Borgomanero.
quote: Tecnologia e comunità oggi – tessere relazioni autentiche in un'epoca (anche) digitale ... sabato 7 marzo ore 17 ... Museo La Manèra, Piazza Chiesa 8, Santa Cristina, Borgomanero.

claim: Grand Hotel Dino's conference centre offers 36 meeting rooms with capacity up to 1,200 delegates, refurbished 2020/21 with current AV and Wi-Fi.
quote: Conference Centre extends over 4,500 sqm and offers 36 elegant and functional meeting rooms with a capacity of up to 1,200 people.

claim: Stresa's Palazzo dei Congressi auditorium holds up to 713 delegates and is the lakefront civic conference venue.
quote: An auditorium that can accommodate up to 713 delegates ... high-speed internet and cutting-edge video conferencing.

claim: Centro Eventi Il Maggiore in Verbania (Pallanza) is a multifunctional venue with theatre hall, meeting/congress hall and outdoor arena.
quote: Il Centro Eventi Il Maggiore di Verbania dispone di sala teatro, ampio foyer, arena esterna, sala incontri per congressi, bar ristorante, spiaggia.

claim: Stresa Festival 2026 (classical and jazz) runs from 16 July to 9 September 2026 — the main cultural event on the lake; not a tech conference.
quote: Stresa Festival 2026 ... from July 16 to September 9 ... classical music and jazz.

claim: The Ambrosetti flagship Cernobbio Forum (52nd edition) runs 4–6 September 2026 at Villa d'Este, Cernobbio — on Lake Como, ~85 km outside the 30 km radius.
quote: 52nd edition of the Cernobbio Forum will be held September 4-5-6, 2026 ... at Villa d'Este in Cernobbio, on the shores of Lake Como, Italy.
